canada.title: N.B. veteran to wear replica medals on Remembrance Day after originals were stolen
canada.summary: A 91-year-old New Brunswick veteran thought he might have to spend this Remembrance Day without his medals after his were stolen from his home this summer. But that won't be the case for retired lieutenant-colonel Alan Kennedy. While they aren't the originals, the replicas, made possible because of the effort of a fellow veteran and kindness of a local businesswoman, will be pinned over his heart on Nov. 11.

bds.h: U.S. judge says Trump’s US$10 billion BBC defamation case can proceed
bds.lede: A federal judge on Tuesday said U.S. President Donald Trump’s US$10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC over a misleadingly edited clip of a speech can go forward, but threw out Trump’s unfair trade practices claim against the broadcaster.
rows: President Donald Trump's $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC will proceed after a judge rejected the outlet's motion to dismiss the case.
A U.S. federal judge has denied a motion to dismiss President Trump's defamation case against the BBC, allowing the case to proceed.
A second claim brought under a Florida consumer protection law was thrown out, halving the original $10bn lawsuit to $5bn, but the US president has still hailed the ruling as “A Huge Victory”.
But the court dismisses the other part of Trump's lawsuit that alleged the BBC had violated a Florida law.
